name: ฐาน Shard เริ่มต้น — ถ่านหินและรับแร่สองทาง
category: 01 เริ่มฐานและ Core
role: ฐานแคมเปญเทคพื้นฐาน ใช้เฉพาะทองแดงและตะกั่วก่อสร้าง
notes: เลือกเป็นฐานตอน launch หลังวิจัยไฟถ่านหิน เสา แบตเตอรี่และสายพาน; ป้อนถ่านหินจากเหมืองเข้าสายล่าง (0,0) ให้เครื่องไฟสามตัว ป้อนทองแดง/แร่จากเหมืองเข้าซ้าย (0,6) และตะกั่ว/แร่อีกชนิดเข้าบน (9,12) ทั้งสองสายเข้า Core; ต่อไฟออกที่เสา (9,4) แบบไม่ขุดแร่ในตัวและไม่ต้องใช้ไฟเริ่มต้น
description:
ฐานแคมเปญเทคพื้นฐาน ใช้เฉพาะทองแดงและตะกั่วก่อสร้าง
เลือกเป็นฐานตอน launch หลังวิจัยไฟถ่านหิน เสา แบตเตอรี่และสายพาน; ป้อนถ่านหินจากเหมืองเข้าสายล่าง (0,0) ให้เครื่องไฟสามตัว ป้อนทองแดง/แร่จากเหมืองเข้าซ้าย (0,6) และตะกั่ว/แร่อีกชนิดเข้าบน (9,12) ทั้งสองสายเข้า Core; ต่อไฟออกที่เสา (9,4) แบบไม่ขุดแร่ในตัวและไม่ต้องใช้ไฟเริ่มต้น

จุดต่อก่อนหมุน (0,0 มุมซ้ายล่าง):
เข้า ถ่านหิน จากเหมืองภายนอก @ 0,0
เข้า ทองแดง/ทรัพยากรจากเหมืองทางซ้าย @ 0,6
เข้า ตะกั่ว/ทรัพยากรจากเหมืองทางบน @ 9,12
ไฟออกไปฐาน; รอถ่านหินถึงเครื่องไฟ @ 9,4

logicAudit.code:
jump 17 equal initialize 1
print "CCER UniPlant 5.66, by cirro, Update: 2026-04-11"
set Complexity 1.00
print "because number of links can affect impact startup conditions, you can change 'Complexity' to make small adjustments to power and battery requirements"
print "set Complexity to 0.00 if your schem only needs base values to start (good for sandbox)"
print "set Complexity to 1.00 (default) to just add a small amount of buffer to start up values (good for a well-designed schem)"
print "set Complexity to 10.00 (or higher) if you see a large delta in Net power or Stored Battery during start up"
set CombHighBatt 0.90
set RTGHighBatt 0.90
set DiffHighBatt 0.95
set SteamHighBatt 0.95
set ThorHighBatt 0.95
set ImpStartP 1500
set ImpStartB 24000
set initialize 1
print "Move Continuous variable below the continuos sensor to bypass fuel saver without using a switch"
set ContinuousRun 1
sensor ContinuousRun switch1 @enabled
set i 0
set rRunning 0
set splitbrain cell1
set loop @counter
getlink link i
sensor type link @type
sensor battCap link @powerNetCapacity
sensor battStored link @powerNetStored
op div BattPerc battStored battCap
jump 86 equal type @thorium-reactor
jump 117 equal type @impact-reactor
jump 36 equal type @overdrive-projector
jump 36 equal type @overdrive-dome
jump 43 equal type @combustion-generator
jump 45 equal type @rtg-generator
jump 47 equal type @differential-generator
jump 50 equal type @steam-generator
jump 38 always type @overdrive-dome
set dometype type
set domelink link
op add i i 1
jump 199 greaterThan i @links
set @counter loop
end
print "Small Plants Section"
set battThresh CombHighBatt
jump 53 always i @links
set battThresh RTGHighBatt
jump 53 always i @links
set battThresh DiffHighBatt
set coolantType @cryofluid
jump 67 always i @links
set battThresh SteamHighBatt
set coolantType @water
jump 67 always i @links
jump 56 notEqual ContinuousRun 1
set genRun 1
jump 60 always ContinuousRun 1
sensor genRunning link @enabled
jump 59 equal genRunning 1
op sub battThresh battThresh 0.2
op lessThan genRun BattPerc battThresh
control enabled link genRun 0 0 0
op add rRunning rRunning genRun
op add i i 1
jump 199 greaterThan i @links
set @counter loop
end
print "DiffSteam Section"
set StartCoolant 0.1
jump 71 notEqual ContinuousRun 1
set lowBatt 1
jump 76 always ContinuousRun 1
sensor genOnline link @enabled
op sub battThresh battThresh 0.1
op lessThan lowBatt BattPerc battThresh
jump 76 equal genOnline 1
op add StartCoolant StartCoolant 1
sensor coolant link coolantType
op greaterThan goodCool coolant StartCoolant
op land runGen lowBatt goodCool
control enabled link runGen 0 0 0
op add rRunning rRunning runGen
op add i i 1
jump 199 greaterThan i @links
set @counter loop
end
print "Thorium Section"
sensor cryo1 link @cryofluid
jump 94 greaterThan cryo1 15
sensor tHeat link @heat
op lessThan heatGood tHeat 0.1
control enabled link heatGood 0 0 0
wait 0.1
control enabled link 0 0 0 0
jump 112 always alwaysThors 1
jump 101 notEqual ContinuousRun 1
control enabled link 1 0 0 0
op add rRunning rRunning 1
op add i i 1
jump 199 greaterThan i @links
set @counter loop
print "Thor FuelSaver section"
sensor battStored link @powerNetStored
op mul battThresh ThorHighBatt battCap
jump 110 lessThanEq battStored battThresh
sensor pNetIn link @powerNetIn
sensor pNetOut link @powerNetOut
op lessThan runThor pNetIn pNetOut
control enabled link runThor 0 0 0
op add rRunning rRunning runThor
jump 112 always battStored battThresh
control enabled link 1 0 0 0
op add rRunning rRunning 1
op add i i 1
jump 199 greaterThan i @links
set @counter loop
end
print "Impact Section"
sensor active link @enabled
sensor blast link @blast-compound
sensor cryo link @cryofluid
jump 124 equal active 1
jump 143 equal active 0
end
print "Impact running, check levels"
op greaterThanEq blastgood blast 1
op greaterThanEq cryogood cryo 3
op land FuelCryo blastgood cryogood
jump 131 equal FuelCryo 1
jump 174 always FuelCryo 1
end
print "Fuel,Cyro good, check heat"
sensor heat link @heat
jump 135 lessThan heat 0.73
op add rRunning rRunning 1
jump 193 always heat 0.73
op add wait @time 10
print "pausing a moment"
jump 136 lessThan @time wait
sensor heat2 link @heat
jump 174 lessThanEq heat2 heat
jump 193 always heat2 heat
end
print "Impact is not running"
op greaterThanEq blastgood blast 3
op greaterThanEq cryogood cryo 5
op land FuelCryo blastgood cryogood
jump 150 equal FuelCryo 1
jump 174 always FuelCryo 1
end
print "impact: check startup params"
sensor timescale link @timescale
op mul powComplex @links Complexity
op add ImpStartPow ImpStartP powComplex
op mul StartPowScale ImpStartPow timescale
sensor pNetIn link @powerNetIn
sensor pNetOut link @powerNetOut
jump 174 lessThan pNetOut 0
op sub pNet pNetIn pNetOut
jump 180 greaterThan pNet StartPowScale
jump 174 lessThan battCap 4000
sensor battStored link @powerNetStored
op mul battComplex @links Complexity
op add ImpStartBatt ImpStartB battComplex
op greaterThanEq battGood battStored ImpStartBatt
op greaterThanEq powGood pNet 0
op land battPowGood battGood powGood
jump 180 equal battPowGood 1
print "impact: blended power and battery determination"
op div TTS 17 timescale
op sub pDuringStart pNet StartPowScale
op mul totPowNeeded pDuringStart TTS
op add battGap battStored totPowNeeded
jump 180 greaterThan battGap 0
print "impact not ready to start"
control enabled link 0 0 0 0
op add i i 1
jump 199 greaterThan i @links
set @counter loop
end
print "impact Start up"
sensor alreadyon link @enabled
jump 193 equal alreadyon 1
read memCheck splitbrain 0
op sub howLong @time memCheck
jump 174 lessThan howLong 250
write @time splitbrain 0
control enabled link 1 0 0 0
set memCheck @time
op add i i 1
jump 199 greaterThan i @links
set @counter loop
end
print "impact continue running"
control enabled link 1 0 0 0
op add i i 1
jump 199 greaterThan i @links
set @counter loop
end
print "OD and Dome Section"
jump 202 lessThanEq rRunning 1
control enabled domelink 1 0 0 0
jump 223 always domeout 1
jump 209 equal dometype @overdrive-dome
jump 207 equal dometype @overdrive-projector
jump 223 always dometype @overdrive-dome
print "no dome found"
end
set ODreq 210
jump 210 always i @links
set ODreq 600
op mul ODbuffer @links Complexity
op add ODpower ODbuffer ODreq
sensor ODpNetIn domelink @powerNetIn
sensor ODpNetOut domelink @powerNetOut
jump 216 greaterThanEq ODpNetOut 0
set ODpNetOut 0
op sub ODpNet ODpNetIn ODpNetOut
op greaterThanEq ODcheck1 ODpNet ODpower
op greaterThan ODcheck2 battStored 8000
op or ODcheck3 ODcheck1 ODcheck2
op greaterThanEq ODcheck4 rRunning 1
op land startOD ODcheck3 ODcheck4
control enabled domelink startOD 0 0 0
read memCheck2 splitbrain 0
op sub howLong2 @time memCheck
jump 231 greaterThan howLong2 300
print "reloop required"
set i 0
set rRunning 0
set @counter loop
end
print "you can add some custom code after this point if you aren't using many thorium reactors"
sensor m1Lead mixer1 @lead
jump 236 greaterThanEq m1Lead 9
control config sorter1 @lead 0 0 0
jump 237 always c1Items 8
control config sorter1 @null 0 0 0
sensor m2Tita mixer2 @titanium
sensor c1Items conveyor1 @totalItems
jump 243 greaterThanEq m2Tita 8
jump 243 greaterThanEq c1Items 8
control enabled incinerator1 0 0 0 0
jump 244 always c1Items 8
control enabled incinerator1 1 0 0 0
end

originalDescription:
Spectre Outpost v1.2.0

by Commanders, Bigspeck, SBytes, The M.
Helped by Yo & Qwertynoob.

<< Features >>
- Manual override gate switches
   - Override enable projectors
   - Override phase feed force projectors
- Multi unit type support
- Multi ammo/turret type support
- Auto disabling POD, 30 seconds after inactivity
- Phase feeding uses ucontrol approach to keep unit centered near container instead of directly on top of phase fed block
- Updated to Supply Crew v2.6.3

<< Activation System >>
Overdrive: If no ODD (on all corners, timescale based) and if one of 3 conditions are true:
- Menders are active
- Less than 250 thorium in container (helps boost SC performance / mass driver loading)
- either of the 2 front turrets are shooting (enemy/building)
Menders:
- Force projectors are active
- One of the walls are damaged / missing
Force projectors: 
- either of the 2 front turrets are shooting

unit is chosen automatically

also improved old unbind system for units to die less and don't waste resources

name: ยูนิตบิน T5 — ครบโซ่ น้ำและไครโอ
role: อัปเกรด T1→T5 จาก Core พร้อมระบบหล่อเย็น
author: y0.
notes:
พื้นที่ 19×27; ต่อ Core/คลังที่มีวัสดุ T1–T5 น้ำจากพื้นและไฟสูง; ตรวจ node connections รอไครโอก่อนผลิต ใช้ switch1 หยุด production; FPS/TPS ต่ำอาจลดประสิทธิภาพ
มี mlog เดิมฝังในแบบ: ห้ามลบ processor หากยังใช้ระบบอัตโนมัติ; ดูวิธีตั้งค่าของผู้สร้างในคู่มือฉบับเต็ม
originalDescription:
Core T5 (logic optional) v1.1

works at 100% efficiency on 1x build speed and > 30 fps/tps.

18.4k/s power maximum
16k/s power average

rotate the exponential-recontructor to the right for t4 production.

check node connections.
/sync when inspecting on multiplayer.

no logic:
 - remove phase-conduit on the t4 reconstructor (near overdrive-dome).

logic:
 - fast startup and resource management logic included.
 - <switch1> disable unit production.
 resource manager:
 config linked <sorter3> near <dome1>
  - @copper => force enable.
  - @lead => skip power check.
  - @metaglass => skip core reources check.

changelog:
 v1.1: fixed force-enable breaking fast startup logic, causing clog.

inspired by Yo & C5's Core T5 and Ciorno's core to t5.

thanks to C5 and Username for cost shaving.
thanks to Username & Yo for resource manager suggestions.

by Angels
discord's arch.angels
description:

logicAudit.code:
print "prevent mixing water"
control enabled extractor1 0 0 0 0
sensor cryo tank1 @cryofluid
jump 1 lessThan cryo 50
control enabled extractor1 1 0 0 0
jump 2 always x false

print "assure enough silicon"
sensor silicon reconstructor1 @silicon
op greaterThanEq res1 silicon 50
control enabled unloader1 res1 0 0 0
print "assure enough titanium"
sensor ti reconstructor2 @titanium
op greaterThanEq res2 ti 150
control enabled unloader2 res2 0 0 0

print "fast initialize"
sensor load reconstructor2 @payloadCount
sensor progress reconstructor2 @progress
jump 8 lessThan load 1
jump 8 greaterThan progress 0.01
control config unloader1 @none 0 0 0
end
print "assure enough silicon&plastanium"
sensor s1 reconstructor1 @silicon
sensor plast reconstructor1 @plastanium
jump 16 lessThan plast 800
jump 14 lessThan s1 1000
control config unloader1 @none 0 0 0
jump 20 always s1 900
control config unloader1 @plastanium 0 0 0
jump 20 always s1 900
jump 19 lessThan s1 1000
control config unloader1 @silicon 0 0 0
jump 20 always s1 900
control config unloader1 @copper 0 0 0
end

print "assure enough titanium/lead"
sensor p0 factory1 @progress
wait 0.1
sensor p1 factory1 @progress
sensor produced factory1 @payloadCount
op sub dp p1 p0
op greaterThan isProducing dp 0
op or res isProducing produced
control enabled smelter1 res 0 0 0
control enabled smelter2 res 0 0 0
control enabled smelter3 res 0 0 0

print "prevent phase clogging"
wait 0.2
sensor phase dome1 @phase-fabric
sensor phase2 conveyor1 @phase-fabric
jump 8 lessThan phase 8
jump 8 greaterThan phase2 1
control enabled unloader1 1 0 0 0
jump 9 always x false
control enabled unloader1 0 0 0 0
end

print "prevent alloy clogging"
wait 0.5
sensor alloy conveyor1 @surge-alloy
op lessThanEq res alloy 2
control enabled conveyor2 res 0 0 0

print "maximize silicon performance"
control config unloader1 @lead 0 0 0
wait 0.4
control config unloader1 @coal 0 0 0
wait 1

print "prevent titanium clogging"
sensor total conveyor1 @totalItems
op lessThanEq res1 total 9
control enabled conveyor2 res1 0 0 0
print "prevent plastanium clogging"
sensor plast conveyor3 @plastanium
op lessThanEq res2 plast 5
control enabled compressor1 res2 0 0 0
control enabled compressor2 res2 0 0 0

name: crawler — สายผลิตถึง T1
role: CRAWLER T1
description:
CRAWLER T1
โรงงานและเครื่องอัปเกรดต่อ payload ไว้ครบ เลือกยูนิตเริ่มต้นแล้ว เว้นพื้นที่ด้านบนให้ยูนิตออก
ต่อวัตถุดิบเข้าขอบซ้ายแต่ละสายที่กำหนด ต้องมี Core และโควตายูนิต; รุ่น T4/T5 ต้องป้อนไครโอแยกแต่ละขั้น
เหมาะเมื่อวางสายผลิตอัปเกรดแยกจากโรงงานวัตถุดิบ

เข้า ซิลิคอน ที่ (0,0) → ขั้น T1 ใช้ 8/รอบ
เข้า ถ่านหิน ที่ (0,1) → ขั้น T1 ใช้ 10/รอบ
เชื่อมไฟที่เสา (8,1)
ยูนิตออกด้านบนสุด; ต้นทุนและทรัพยากรแต่ละขั้นเพิ่มตามระดับ
พิกัดจากซ้ายล่างเริ่ม 0 ก่อนหมุน
ใช้ไฟสูงสุดตามสูตรรวมประมาณ 72/วินาทีเมื่อเครื่องทำงานพร้อมกัน
author: ออกแบบสำหรับชุด Serpulo ไทย
measuredSummary: สร้าง crawler ออกมาจริง 96 ตัวใน 1000 วินาที จากสายผลิตครบขั้น; ทดสอบการผลิต ไม่ใช่การรบ

originalDescription:
Cirro Corp. Energy Research

Manages the safe run of (many) Thorium reactors.  Use a single processor to connect to as many reactors that it can reach (processor size doesn't matter)

[features]
-system runs quickly enough to check all Reactors' cryo levels.
-if cryo levels dip below half, the reactor will be shutdown.
-automatically saves resources by shutting reactors when batteries are full - but only if it has time to check the whole farm. You can ensure it has time by covering the processor with an overdrive, or by ensuring only thorium reactors and overdrives are linked to this processor.
-also connect this to OD or ODD and this will enable/disable with the farm.
-will kickStart your reactor farm by very quickly cycling a dry reactor to produce a small amount of power.  any reactors that have been slightly heated this way will not be used again for this purpose until after they've been cooled.
-if the system was running but the cryo supply gets cut off the reactor farm will shutdown. the system will then attempt to restart itself using the local supply of cryo one reactor at a time. it will exhaust all cryo across all reactors before attempting a kickStart.

[options]
kickStart = 1 (default) will enable the kickStart function.  
change this to 0 in the processor variables if you are not comfortable with any heat at all.

[test conditions]
-30fps and 60fps.
-small proc connected to 37 reactors.
-medium connected to 157.
-large connected to 564.
-with ODD, OD and without.
-randomized coolant failures.

originalDescription:
Cirro Corp. Energy Research
by cirro, 2026-08-16

-Manages start and run of all Serpulo generators and reactors at the same time.
-Place the UniPlant processor and connect to all your reactors and generators it can reach.
-Connect to OD/dome, and those too will be started up when there's sufficient power.
-If you want to bypass the resource saver, you can link it to an enabled switch.

Impact:
-Activates an impact only when the bare minimum of power, battery, fuel, and coolant are availble, despite how many are connected.
-If you have a large schem with impacts out of reach of the proc, you can set up multiple UniPlants that are all connected to the same memcell - They will then automatically share start data with each other, and act as one (split-brain function).
-If you stack multiple impact schematics together, you can link up to two other uniplant procs, and information will be shared between them.

Thorium:
-Uses the self-start capability of Thorium reactors, so no external input power is required to start up a Thorium plant (plants will flash briefly while they try to build coolant).
-Because UniPlant checks for many different plant types, limit the number of connected Thorium reactors to 7.  If your schem has many thorium reactors and no other types, using CCER SuperThor is recommended instead of UniPlant.
-Fuel saver will only activate reactors if netpower is negative or when batts are below 95%.

Small Generators:
-run if below 90% battery, and then only if net power dips to negative

Updates:
-simplified small generators section and improved net power checking.
-improved overdrive logic to reduce start up flapping.
-overall reduction in code lines, and clean up of variables.
-added processor connect for impact schematic stacking.

logicAudit.code:
jump 15 equal initialize 1
print "CCER UniPlant 6.01, by cirro, Update: 2026-08-16"
set Complexity 200
print "because number of links can affect impact startup conditions, you can change 'Complexity' to make small adjustments to power and battery requirements"
print "set Complexity to 0.00 if your schem only needs base values to start (good for sandbox)"
print "set Complexity to 1.00 to just add a small amount of buffer to start up values (good for a well-designed schem)"
print "set Complexity to 100.00 (or higher) if you see a large delta in Net power or Stored Battery during start up"
print "connect as many impacts as you can to a single proc for better control.  if you see many false starts, increase the complexity value"
set smallGenBatt 0.90
set ThorHighBatt 0.95
set ImpStartP 1500
set ImpStartB 24000
set initialize 1
print "Move Continuous variable below the continuos sensor to bypass fuel saver without using a switch"
set ContinuousRun 1
sensor ContinuousRun switch1 @enabled
set rRunning 0
set i -1
set loop @counter
op add i i 1
jump 171 greaterThanEq i @links
getlink link i
sensor type link @type
sensor battCap link @powerNetCapacity
sensor battStored link @powerNetStored
op div BattPerc battStored battCap
jump 56 equal type @thorium-reactor
jump 84 equal type @impact-reactor
jump 35 equal type @overdrive-projector
jump 35 equal type @overdrive-dome
jump 42 equal type @combustion-generator
jump 42 equal type @rtg-generator
jump 40 equal type @differential-generator
jump 40 equal type @steam-generator
set @counter loop
set dometype type
set domelink link
set @counter loop
end
print "Small Plants Section"
sensor smallGenCoolant link @totalLiquids
jump 49 lessThan smallGenCoolant 1
sensor smallGenFuel link @totalItems
jump 49 lessThan smallGenFuel 1
jump 51 greaterThanEq ContinuousRun 1
jump 51 lessThan BattPerc smallGenBatt
sensor pNetIn link @powerNetIn
sensor pNetOut link @powerNetOut
jump 51 lessThan pNetIn pNetOut
control enabled link 0 0 0 0
jump 53 always BattPerc smallGenBatt
control enabled link 1 0 0 0
op add rRunning rRunning 1
set @counter loop
end
print "Thorium Section"
sensor thorCryo link @cryofluid
jump 64 greaterThan thorCryo 15
sensor thorHeat link @heat
op lessThan thorHeatGood thorHeat 0.1
control enabled link thorHeatGood 0 0 0
wait 0.1
control enabled link 0 0 0 0
set @counter loop
jump 70 notEqual ContinuousRun 1
control enabled link 1 0 0 0
op add rRunning rRunning 1
set @counter loop
end
print "Thor FuelSaver section"
sensor battStored link @powerNetStored
op mul battThresh ThorHighBatt battCap
jump 79 lessThanEq battStored battThresh
sensor pNetIn link @powerNetIn
sensor pNetOut link @powerNetOut
op lessThan runThor pNetIn pNetOut
control enabled link runThor 0 0 0
op add rRunning rRunning runThor
set @counter loop
control enabled link 1 0 0 0
op add rRunning rRunning 1
set @counter loop
end
print "Impact Section"
sensor impActive link @enabled
set impRecheck 1
sensor impBlast link @blast-compound
sensor impCryo link @cryofluid
jump 96 equal processor1 @null
read impRemoteCheck processor1 "impRecentStart"
jump 92 lessThan impRemoteCheck impRecentStart
set impRecentStart impRemoteCheck
jump 96 equal processor2 @null
read impRemoteCheck processor2 "impRecentStart"
jump 102 lessThan impRemoteCheck impRecentStart
set impRecentStart impRemoteCheck
jump 102 equal cell1 @null
read impRemoteCheck cell1 0
jump 101 lessThan impRemoteCheck impRecentStart
set impRecentStart impRemoteCheck
jump 102 always impRemoteCheck impRecentStart
write impRecentStart cell1 0
jump 106 equal impActive 1
jump 118 equal impActive 0
end
print "Impact is running, checking fuel, cryo, and run heat"
jump 144 lessThan impBlast 1
jump 144 lessThan impCryo 3
sensor impHeat link @heat
jump 112 lessThan impHeat 0.73
op add rRunning rRunning 1
jump 167 always impHeat 0.73
wait 0.1
sensor impHeat2 link @heat
jump 144 lessThanEq impHeat2 impHeat
jump 167 always impHeat2 impHeat
end
print "Impact is not running, yet, check startup params"
jump 144 lessThan impBlast 3
jump 144 lessThan impCryo 5
sensor timescale link @timescale
op mul powComplex @links Complexity
op add ImpStartPow ImpStartP powComplex
op mul StartPowScale ImpStartPow timescale
sensor pNetIn link @powerNetIn
sensor pNetOut link @powerNetOut
jump 144 lessThan pNetOut 0
op sub pNet pNetIn pNetOut
jump 148 greaterThan pNet StartPowScale
jump 144 lessThan battCap 4000
sensor battStored link @powerNetStored
op mul battComplex @links Complexity
op add ImpStartBatt ImpStartB battComplex
op greaterThanEq battGood battStored ImpStartBatt
op greaterThanEq powGood pNet 0
op land battPowGood battGood powGood
jump 148 equal battPowGood 1
print "impact: blended power and battery determination"
op div TTS 17 timescale
op sub pDuringStart pNet StartPowScale
op mul totPowNeeded pDuringStart TTS
op add battGap battStored totPowNeeded
jump 148 greaterThan battGap 0
print "impact not ready to start"
control enabled link 0 0 0 0
set @counter loop
end
print "impact Start up"
sensor impActive link @enabled
jump 167 equal impActive 1
op sub howLong @time impRecentStart
jump 154 greaterThan howLong 300
control enabled link 0 0 0 0
set @counter loop
jump 161 lessThan impRecheck 1
op sub impRecheck impRecheck 1
op rand impRand 500 impRecentStart
jump 161 lessThan impRand 100
op div impPause impRand 1000
wait impPause
jump 86 always impRecheck 1
control enabled link 1 0 0 0
set impRecentStart @time
write impRecentStart cell1 0
set @counter loop
end
print "impact continue running"
control enabled link 1 0 0 0
set @counter loop
end
print "OD and Dome Section"
jump 176 equal dometype @overdrive-dome
jump 174 equal dometype @overdrive-projector
end
set ODreq 210
jump 177 always i @links
set ODreq 600
sensor ODpNetIn domelink @powerNetIn
sensor ODpNetOut domelink @powerNetOut
op add ODpNetOutNew ODpNetOut ODreq
op greaterThanEq ODcheck1 ODpNetIn ODpNetOutNew
op greaterThan ODcheck2 battStored 8000
op or ODcheck3 ODcheck1 ODcheck2
op greaterThanEq ODcheck4 rRunning 1
op land startOD ODcheck3 ODcheck4
jump 189 equal startOD 1
op sub ODrun ODrun 1
jump 190 greaterThanEq ODrun 0
jump 192 always ODrun 0
set ODrun 1
control enabled domelink 1 0 0 0
end
control enabled domelink 0 0 0 0

Cirro Corp. Energy Research

[instructions]
-Connect the bottom/processor end  to your power plant or farm.  
-Connect the top/message end to your factories or front line turrets.

[features]
-Uses a historesis switch for smooth and predictable operation.
-Lets energy into your cold powerplant so it can start itself indepedently of the rest of your grid. Perfect for Impact schems that require precise power storage to kickstart.   Logicless diode systems won't do this for you.
-Your power plants are now safe from forced shutdown from overloading demand.
-Gives feedback on your power state and will make recommendations for more power or batteries if needed.

originalDescription:
Frontline Healing v1.2
by Yo and SBytes

<< Description >>
- Place in the frontlines to help heal ally units. 
- Good for pushing forward against high dps enemy turrets.
- Supports triple-binding.
- Max ~600 distance from core (only applies for when phase is constantly used, ie mending or activating shields).

<< Usage Instructions >>
- Set left most unloader to phase to force shields to activate at all times.
